meta.title: Gig Radar
meta.description: Curated radar of live gigs in traditional jazz and roots-Americana genres around London and reachable from Surbiton.
meta.scope: Greater London plus places easily reached by train from Surbiton (SW London hub + central London via Waterloo); occasional day-trips flagged with travel notes.

gigs.title: Rose's Pawn Shop
gigs.note: US band billed as old-time Appalachian folk/country — leans Americana/newgrass. Tonight.

gigs.title: Maverick Festival 2026
gigs.artist: Waco Brothers, Vandoliers, Carter Sampson & 40+ acts
gigs.note: The UK's original roots/Americana festival, skews trad. Overnight/camping trip — nearest station Wickham Market, ~2h15 from Liverpool St + taxi.

gigs.title: Tim Penn & The Second Line
gigs.note: New Orleans blues/second-line jazz. Live 21:00–23:00 + late set. Cover on the door, no tickets.

gigs.title: Dom Durner's Black Tie Riot
gigs.note: Billed as hot jazz and swing. Live 21:00–23:00 + late set.

gigs.title: Brennen Leigh
gigs.note: Nashville-based; honky-tonk heart with western-swing snap (cut a full western-swing album with Asleep at the Wheel). Matinée + evening shows.

gigs.title: The Travelling Janes
gigs.note: Swing jazz, blues and early roots.

gigs.title: The Hot Seats
gigs.note: Hard-driving old-time, ragtime and jug blues.

gigs.title: London Barndance — Linda Game Band
gigs.note: Linda Game is a US (Portland) old-time fiddler & Sail Away Ladies member, so likely old-time repertoire — genre fit unconfirmed. 8–11pm.

gigs.title: Swing Dance Sundays — The Big Swing Big Band
gigs.note: Free class + live big-band swing dancing, 14:00–17:00.

gigs.title: Dave Sutherland's Sunday Service feat. Ags Connolly
gigs.note: Ags Connolly = leading UK traditional/ameripolitan country singer (Ray Price / Merle Haggard-era honky tonk). Free Sunday session, 15:00–18:30.

gigs.title: Tuba Skinny
gigs.note: New Orleans trad-jazz US touring band; first of three London shows.

gigs.title: Slo County Stumblers
gigs.note: Old-time string band — clawhammer banjo and bass.

gigs.title: Tuba Skinny
gigs.note: New Orleans trad jazz at Ronnie Scott's (first of two nights).

gigs.title: Tuba Skinny
gigs.note: Second Ronnie Scott's date.

gigs.title: David Graham & The Eskimo Brothers, with Ben Waters
gigs.artist: David Graham & The Eskimo Brothers (+ Ben Waters, Ian Jennings)
gigs.note: Nashville honky-tonk/rockabilly/roots trio; Ben Waters on boogie-woogie piano. Cross-confirmed on band + artist sites. Local — Putney.

gigs.title: Lachlan Bryan & The Wildes
gigs.note: Australian traditional-leaning 'country noir' — more alt-country than pure honky tonk; verify fit.

gigs.title: Swing Dance Sundays — KIX Jazz Orchestra
gigs.note: Free class + big-band swing, 14:00–17:00.

gigs.title: The Jake Leg Jug Band
gigs.note: Lunchtime jug-band set (2×50 min) — jazz/blues/ragtime/vaudeville.

gigs.title: Hank Wangford & The Big Bass Combo
gigs.artist: Hank Wangford & The Big Bass Combo
gigs.note: Long-running British classic-country institution playing Hank Williams-era honky tonk / cosmic country. Squarely on-brief.

gigs.title: East Grinstead Jazz Festival 2026
gigs.artist: The Sussex Stompers (New Orleans trad) + others
gigs.note: Includes a New Orleans-tradition marching procession along the High St (Sat). Day-trip: direct trains from Victoria/London Bridge ~1h.

gigs.title: South London SwingFest
gigs.artist: Elise Roth & her Harvard Squares (eve) / Pete Long & Denny Ilett (aft)
gigs.note: Swing-dance festival; evening set (Harvard Squares, 19:30) is classic swing. Afternoon 'R&Bebop' set leans modern.

gigs.title: The Thumping Tommys
gigs.note: Irish and American folk in old-time style.

gigs.title: Swing Dance Sundays — South London Jazz Orchestra
gigs.note: Free class + big-band swing.

gigs.title: Martha Spencer Trio
gigs.note: Genuine Appalachian (Whitetop, VA) old-time string-band sound.

gigs.title: Dustbowl Revival
gigs.note: Old-school bluegrass/gospel/jug-band/swamp-blues revue; big Americana band, jug-band tag is loose.

gigs.title: Swing Dance Sundays — Sid Bolan Big Band
gigs.note: Free class + big-band swing.

gigs.title: Ags Connolly (solo)
gigs.note: Traditional honky-tonk/Texas country. Winchester is direct from Surbiton on the SW mainline (~1h). Start time assumed ~20:00 — verify.

gigs.title: Richard Bennett's New Orleans All Stars
gigs.artist: Richard Bennett's New Orleans All Stars
gigs.note: Lunchtime trad-jazz session (doors 11:30, 12–3pm), Shooting Star Chase fundraiser. Year not printed on listing but Sep 10 is a Thursday in 2026 — confirm with venue.

gigs.title: La Bouche Manouche feat. Irene Serra
gigs.note: Top UK vintage gypsy-jazz band (Django/Hot Club style) at London's current premier manouche venue. Listed on JamBase but not yet corroborated elsewhere — confirm with the venue.

gigs.title: Swing Dance Sundays — Duke Street Big Band
gigs.note: Free class + big-band swing.

gigs.title: Stompin' at the 100 Club — Denmark Street Big Band
gigs.note: Swing-dance night; class 19:45, live band 20:45 & 21:45.

gigs.title: London Barndance — Sail Away Ladies
gigs.note: Appalachian all-female old-time band + US caller — genuine old-time square/contra dance. 8–11pm.

gigs.title: The Red Hot Rhythm Revival Jazz Band
gigs.artist: The Red Hot Rhythm Revival Jazz Band
gigs.note: 1920s/30s New Orleans/hot-jazz quintet. Excellar has Surbiton (18–20 Brighton Rd) and Kingston branches — confirm branch/time. Right on the doorstep.

gigs.title: The Jake Leg Jug Band
gigs.note: Epsom is a short direct train from Surbiton.

gigs.title: EFG London Jazz Festival 2026 (trad / gypsy strands)
gigs.note: Festival dates confirmed; reliably carries trad/hot/gypsy strands. Cherry-pick manouche/trad gigs from the What's On listing.

gigs.title: The Jake Leg Jug Band
gigs.note: Datchet is on the Waterloo line (via Staines).

gigs.title: Harlem Orchestra
gigs.note: 1920s–40s Harlem hot-jazz/swing. Lunchtime session (doors 11:30, 12–3pm). Year not printed but Dec 3 is a Thursday in 2026 — confirm with venue.

gigs.title: Jingle Bell Jive — South London Jazz Orchestra
gigs.note: After-hours swing dance; class 18:30, live sets 19:30 & 21:15.

gigs.title: Stompin' at the 100 Club — Malcolm Earle-Smith Swingin' All Stars
gigs.note: Swing-dance night; class 19:45, live band 20:45 & 21:45.

gigs.title: Christmas Eve Dance — Five Go Jiving
gigs.note: Swing dance; classes 13:00 & 14:45, live sets 14:00 & 15:05.

gigs.title: Swing Into Christmas — Down for the Count Swing Orchestra
gigs.artist: Down for the Count Swing Orchestra
gigs.note: Classic big-band swing. Two shows: 14:00 & 19:00.

watchlist.name: Toulouse Lautrec Jazz Club
watchlist.note: Current premier London gypsy-jazz venue (La Bouche Manouche, London Django Collective). Autumn 2026 calendar not yet published; London Gypsy Jazz Festival 16–19 Apr is out of window. Re-check monthly.

watchlist.name: Vortex Jazz Club — 'Gypsy Jazz Monthly'
watchlist.note: Monthly Roma/manouche residency (Gina Boreham) since 2006. Individual Jul–Dec 2026 dates not yet on the JS calendar.

watchlist.name: Crazy Coqs / Brasserie Zedel
watchlist.note: Recurring hot/gypsy shows: Peter Golding's 'Café Django', Harry Diplock Trio, Paris hot-jazz nights. Specific autumn 2026 dates not yet posted; event system sometimes errors.

watchlist.name: London Django Collective
watchlist.venue: Pizza Express Soho / Vortex / Green Note
watchlist.note: Matt Holborn & Harry Diplock's Django ensemble; regular London dates. No confirmed Jul–Dec 2026 date found yet.

watchlist.name: Trio Manouche
watchlist.note: Leading UK gypsy-swing ensemble; plays EFG London Jazz Festival (Nov). Confirm in-window London dates on their site.

watchlist.name: Boisdale (Belgravia & Canary Wharf)
watchlist.note: Daily live jazz including gypsy/Django-style swing — browse the calendar for dated shows.

watchlist.name: Nightjar
watchlist.note: Nightly 21:00 hot jazz/swing/New Orleans, cover on the door. Only publishes ~2 weeks ahead — re-scrape each run for Aug–Dec dates.

watchlist.name: Shirt Tail Stompers — Sunday residency
watchlist.note: London's top vintage 1920s–40s Harlem swing/hot-jazz band; recurring Sunday residency. Specific H2-2026 dates not retrievable (site blocks fetch).

watchlist.name: Ron's Honky Tonk
watchlist.note: Recurring honky-tonk night with US/UK acts. Only past 2026 dates found so far — watch for autumn dates.

watchlist.name: The Dukes of Highgate
watchlist.note: London's dedicated honky-tonk bar. Calendar widget hides later dates from scrapers — check directly for Aug–Dec 2026 live bands.

watchlist.name: What's Cookin'
watchlist.note: Wed/Sat roots nights spanning western swing & old country. Current H2 bookings skew blues/country-soul — monitor for trad-country bills.

watchlist.name: The Bull's Head — jazz 7 nights/week
watchlist.note: Regularly books gypsy/trad/hot acts, but current H2 diary is mostly modern/bebop/tributes. Local — recheck for target-genre nights.

watchlist.name: Jazz at the Boaters — free weekly Sunday jazz
watchlist.note: Longest-running weekly free jazz night, Sundays ~20:30. Mostly mainstream/modern; occasional swing/trad. Very local.

watchlist.name: The Winning Post — monthly trad/New Orleans jazz lunches
watchlist.note: Regular Thursday 12–3pm trad/New Orleans jazz fundraiser sessions (see confirmed-ish 10 Sep & 3 Dec). Local — watch for further dates.

watchlist.name: Excellar (Ex Cellar Wine Cafe)
watchlist.note: Books occasional trad/hot & gypsy jazz on the doorstep (Red Hot Rhythm Revival 31 Oct). Watch for more trad bookings.

watchlist.name: The Lamb — weekly roots/folk/jazz
watchlist.note: Free weekly grassroots nights (Thu & Sun) + last-Wed Irish trad session + annual Lambstock. Listings are Facebook/Instagram only — the social-access gap. Right in Surbiton.

watchlist.name: The Fighting Cocks — roots/trad one-offs only
watchlist.note: Per the venue rule, only include cajun/rockabilly/hot-jazz/country one-offs. Current H2 diary is entirely rock/tribute — nothing qualifying yet.

watchlist.name: File Gumbo Cajun Music & Dance Club
watchlist.note: Britain's longest-running cajun dance club. Website not loading; likely social-only. Check Facebook (@LondonCajun) for 2026 dance dates.

watchlist.name: Cajun Jam Session at The Harrison
watchlist.note: Recurring accordion/fiddle-led cajun jam (File Gumbo, New River Ramblers, London Cajun Jammers). No published 2026 dates — follow @TheHarrisonFolk.

watchlist.name: Plaquemine Lock (Louisiana pub)
watchlist.note: Regular weekend zydeco/New Orleans live music. 2026 dates not yet published.

watchlist.name: FOAOTMAD old-time session
watchlist.note: Old-time Appalachian string-band session, 1st & 3rd Sunday, 14:30–17:30. Recurring — no specific dates listed.

watchlist.name: Soho Jazz Festival 2026
watchlist.note: Dates confirmed 16–19 Sep; line-up revealed late Aug. Grassroots/discovery focus — check for trad/hot-jazz strands then.

watchlist.name: Gloucester Cajun & Zydeco Festival
watchlist.note: Europe's longest-running cajun/zydeco fest, but the 2026 edition is 30 Jan–1 Feb — outside the summer window. Note for the winter radar.
